description: three grounded questions, one with a binary secondary source

questions.question: In Orbit's watcher, which type receives a debounced batch of disk events?
questions.hint: Look at the impl block in the index module's watcher.
questions.explanation: WatchContext::handle in src/index/watcher.rs takes the batch and reindexes it; the gateway never sees disk events.

questions.question: Orbit debounces disk events for 200 ms before updating its index.
questions.hint: The architecture page has an Index section.
questions.explanation: docs/architecture.md says batches are debounced for 200 ms; DEBOUNCE_MS in the watcher holds the value.

questions.question: Which method of AiGateway stops a running operation?
questions.hint: Read the second method of the gateway's impl block.
questions.explanation: AiGateway::cancel in src/ai/gateway.rs stops the slot's operation by id.
